summary: Independent verification of the Rapid Fire chapter-picker redesign (BUG 1-7 and the flex-switching goals the owner asked for). Every one of BUG 1-7 is VERIFIED FIXED. No application code was changed; no account was written to. Logic check `node /app/tests/rf_picker_logic_check.js` = all passed (encode/decode round-trips at 1, 3, 5, 6, 78, 105, 110 picks; short lists byte-for-byte as before; names match backend/scope.py for the whole table; ceiling refused at >150). UI check `python3 /app/tests/rf_picker_check.py` passed 40/40 at 390x844 (app web preview), the same 40/40 at 360x640 (`small`), the same 40/40 at /api/arena (`arena`), and the same 40/40 at /api/arena 360x640 (`arena small`) - 160 of 160 UI checks. The script verifies for both the app and the browser copy: (A) Quick Play opens on the PCM tab with no chapter ticked, Select all under the tabs and above the chapter list, SAVE / PLAY disabled with helpful sub-text, no 'up to 5' anywhere, no horizontal scroll, every key >= 44 px tall and fully visible; (B) Select all ticks every chapter of the tab in view and names the round correctly (PCM Mixed when PCM is full, Mixed Chemistry when only Chemistry); (C) one chapter can be unticked after Select all, Clear unticks the tab in view, ticking the same chapter again goes back to All selected; (D) Clear works; (E) flexible switching - ticks on one tab survive a tab change, Chemistry chips sit next to 'Physics all', a tray chip clears that subject only, Reasoning has its own tab labelled BITSAT 2026; (F) search spans every subject with the subject name on the row, a chapter ticked in search stays ticked; (G) closing without saving and reopening is plain again; (H) PLAY with 78 chapters sends picks as a list of 78, Quick Match, 30 cards, route stays 2218 bytes; (I) after a round the lobby's picker is plain again; (J) Solo Sprint always opens the picker, button reads 'START SOLO SPRINT' and is disabled until something is ticked, second time it is still plain; (K) Practice Rival opens the picker, with 'Select all' on the Chemistry tab the POST body is picks=[{subject:'Chemistry', chapter:null}] - exactly the old shape; (L) Play Friends ribbon shows the last saved battleground and its picker opens ON it (per the regression rule), a chapter can be unticked there too. No write left the browser on any run (`Z1`); no React hook / 'Cannot update a component' / key warning in any run (`Z3`). BACKEND REGRESSION `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_rf_free_picks.py tests/test_rf_phase3.py tests/test_rf_phase3_live_api.py tests/test_rf_phase4.py tests/test_rf_rules_june2026.py tests/test_iter73_scale.py tests/test_iter74_multiserver.py tests/test_iter75_review.py tests/test_iter65_cup_night_badla.py tests/test_iter66_crown_guard_lead.py tests/test_rf_iter61_new_apis.py tests/test_rf_weak_topics.py tests/test_rf_weak_topics_extra.py tests/test_phase3_live_regression.py tests/test_phase2_split_regression_live.py tests/test_rf_iter20_free_entry.py tests/test_iter113_deploy_startup_fixes.py tests/test_phase2_speed.py -q` = 124 passed / 11 skipped / 0 failed in 81.4 s; `test_iter73_scale::test_practice_rival_match_lite_and_full_frames` finished cleanly (the flake the hand-off mentioned was NOT seen). `tests/test_arena_web_complete.py -q` = 9 passed in 1.4 s. That confirms backend-side: /api/rf/sessions /duels /challenges /cups accept up to 150 chapter picks, deal an even share per ticked chapter and never deal a chapter that was not ticked, label long lists as '<n> chapters · <subjects>' and store a '#' + 40 hex digest; 151 is refused; two players sending the same long list in a different order still meet in Quick Match and a different list does not; up-to-5 payloads (including the older subject + chapter body) are matched/dealt/labelled byte-for-byte as before (PCM Mixed cycles Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics 10 each; 'Mixed Maths +1 more'; '<chapter> +2 more'; scope_key of short lists equals the old 'Subject:chapter|...' string; 30/50/100 counts and the 101 -> 422 rule; rematch Badla and cups on old picks). AUDIT of the 'anything the main agent may have missed' list: (1) every grep hit for 'up to 5' outside tests/history traces to the SEAT limit of a Match Room (5 players per side of a gang war, 'Up to 5 players per match' in backend/rooms.py / duels.py / gang screens), NOT to the chapter-pick ceiling - the chapter-pick 'Up to 5' was removed from the sheet (A8); (2) frontend/app/rapid/session.tsx, challenge.tsx, cup/index.tsx and src/rapid/MatchResult.tsx / HeadToHead.tsx all decode `picks` via decodePicks() + picksFrom() fallback, which reads both the new grouped-by-subject shape (`{"Physics":["Optics","Waves"]}` for > 5 picks) and the classic flat array (for <= 5 picks), and also the older subject + chapter route param - so rematch from MatchResult, /rapid/session reload with a long picks param, the challenge room header, the cup hub, the watch screen and history rows all work on long lists; (3) scope.ts encodePicks keeps a 110-chapter payload at 3,265 bytes (well under the 8 KB server limit); (4) scopeLabel returns 'PCM Mixed' / 'Mixed <subject>' / '<chapter> +n more' for <=5 picks (byte-for-byte as before) and switches to '<n> chapters · <subjects>' for >5, so no card overflows; (5) picksFrom still accepts the legacy subject + chapter pair, so an OLD client (plain array of up to 5 picks, or subject + chapter) still gets exactly the old answers. One picture per window saved under /tmp/picker_runs/ (opens_plain, select_all, one_unticked, solo_asks, play_friends). Deprecated expo packages detected: none (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in /app/frontend/package.json or source).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/rapid/scope.ts packs > 5 picks grouped by subject (Record<subject, chapters | 0>) and decodes both shapes via decodePicks + picksFrom fallback. At 110 chapters the route param is 3,265 bytes vs 9,371 in the classic form, so the address stays well under any browser/server limit.

backend/scope.py keeps CLASSIC_PICKS = 5 as the behaviour switch: up to 5, label/scope_key/matching/dealing are byte-identical to before; above 5 the label becomes '<n> chapters · <subjects>' and scope_key becomes '#' + sha256[:40], so cross-order lists still match and the index stays small. MAX_PICKS = 150 is only a request ceiling.

ScopeSheet starts empty (value starts as []), reads from the catalog once, draws about 30 rows at a time (FlatList) so checks must go through tab badges / tray chips / SAVE sub-line instead of counting the DOM - the rf_picker_check.py script does exactly that.

Solo Sprint (rf-start-button) and Practice Rival (rf-duel-ai) now ALWAYS open ScopeSheet first (LobbyTab passes value=[] and only writes setScope on save), so the owner's complaint 'opens with a subject and all its chapters already selected' is gone on both tiles as well as on Quick Play.

Play Friends / Knockout Cup / Gang War keep the OLD behaviour of opening the sheet on the last saved battleground (that is the correct regression rule: those screens are there to change a saved pick), and from there any chapter can still be unticked. Verified in L1 / L2 of the check.
No 'up to 5' remains in the chapter-pick path; every grep hit for 'up to 5' is the SEAT count (Match Room / gang war team size), which is a different limit and unchanged.

success_rate.backend: 100% (124 passed + 11 skipped + 9 arena_web passed = 133/133 of what was asked; 0 failed)

seed_data_creation: None. The QA learner (owner's real account, read only) signed in once per run. Every POST under /api/rf/sessions and /api/rf/duels was answered 400 by the browser after reading the body (2 match requests + 1 sprint request per run were refused inside the browser); every other write under /api/rf/{sessions,duels,challenges,cups} was aborted before leaving the browser and counted (there were none on any of the four runs). No throw-away TEST- player was created either: the backend regression files use their own TEST- players and clean them up (as test_rf_phase3.py does).
